name: com.atommerce.maca_android_sdk.fcm.MyFirebaseMessagingService
description: Atommerce's Maca Android SDK receives Firebase push messages and registers refreshed push tokens; it posts community, counseling, chat, and call alerts and routes relevant taps to the app's screens.
disableEffect: The app may miss community, counseling, chat, and call alerts from this SDK, and related notifications may not open their intended screen.
